purpose: Define deterministic, source-bound daily decision-intelligence projections above the NEE Knowledge Base without promoting a projection into a graph fact, status field, recommendation, or release action.

system_of_record.name: NEE Knowledge Base
system_of_record.role: Canonical facts and governed source evidence
system_of_record.daily_intelligence_role: Derived, audience-scoped, candidate-only workspace outside the graph release path

forbidden: untimed status text treated as current

invariants: Every material daily artifact is DERIVED_CANDIDATE_ONLY and graph_mutation_authorized is false.

Every material daily artifact has explicit source assertion IDs, observation IDs when applicable, valid-time as_of, known-time known_at, expiry, review state, validation questions, and a falsification criterion.
A missing or expired observation yields STALE_OR_UNKNOWN, never an inferred healthy status.
A conflicting observation yields HITL_REQUIRED and cannot be collapsed to one value.
W5 filters records before findings, titles, source IDs, gaps, counts, or artifact fields are projected; all record labels are derived from immutable cited sources.
No daily projection can write to the NEE Knowledge Base or alter query ranking, graph rows, index rows, runtime state, or release state.

projection_rules.change_brief: Compare source-bound temporal observations at two as-of times and expose changed state/value with linked source evidence.
projection_rules.decision_inbox: Surface only current, audience-visible unresolved decisions. Missing ownership or a blocking state requires HITL.
projection_rules.readiness_gap: Evaluate required scope/dimension combinations using W3 projection states and surface missing, stale, or conflicting evidence without fabricating readiness.
projection_rules.dependency_warning: Surface current, audience-visible unresolved cross-scope dependencies with source evidence and expiry.
projection_rules.meeting_brief: Aggregate daily artifacts as a candidate briefing with validation questions; it must not turn a candidate into an approved recommendation.
